# Appwrite Docs

> Appwrite documentation covering products, APIs, SDKs, tooling, self-hosting, and platform guides.

Full documentation content (single file): https://appwrite.io/llms-full.txt

Top-level docs index: https://appwrite.io/docs.md

Every page below is also available as Markdown by appending `.md` to its URL.

## Billing

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing.md): Understand Appwrite's plans, add-ons, service level agreements, and billing policies.
- [Manage billing](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/payments.md): Understand Appwrite's billing features, like budget caps, billing periods, taxes, and more.

### Plans

- [Free](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/free.md): Appwrite's Free plan provides a generous free tier. Perfect for budding projects, hobbiests, and side-projects.
- [Pro](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/pro.md): Understand Appwrite's pricing plans, behaviors, billing cycles, and limitations.
- [Enterprise](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/enterprise.md): How Appwrite can accelerate enterprise development teams and provide custom support and hosting options.
- [Open source](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/oss.md): Learn how Appwrite supports open-source projects by providing free credits and other benefits.

### Add ons

- [Compute](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/compute.md): Learn about CPU and memory options for Appwrite Functions and Sites on Cloud, including separate build and runtime specifications and plan build timeouts.
- [Phone OTP](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/phone-otp.md): Learn how Appwrite handles SMS-based OTP authentication for secure user verification.
- [Image Transformations](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/image-transformations.md): Learn how to transform images using Appwrite's storage API.
- [Database Reads and Writes](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/database-reads-and-writes.md): Learn how Appwrite handles database reads and writes and their associated costs.

### SLAs

- [Support SLA](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/support-sla.md): Learn about Appwrite's support service level agreement (SLA) including response times, severity levels, and support commitments for different subscription tiers.
- [Uptime SLA](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/uptime-sla.md): Learn about Appwrite's uptime service level agreement and commitments for different subscription plans.

### Policies

- [Fair use](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/fair-use-policy.md): Understand Appwrite's usage limits, prohibited activities, and enforcement actions.
- [Abuse](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/abuse.md): Guidelines on abusive behavior, prohibited activities, and reporting mechanisms under our Fair Use Policy.
- [Refund](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/billing/refund-policy.md): Learn about Appwrite's refund policy for services, including eligibility criteria and the request process.

## Migrations

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/migrations.md): Learn how to use Appwrite Migrations service to move projects from other vendors to Appwrite Cloud or from self-hosting to Cloud and the other way around.

### Guides

- [From Firebase](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/migrations/firebase.md): Migrate seamlessly from Firebase to Appwrite. Learn how to transfer data, authentication, and services from Firebase to leverage Appwrite's capabilities.
- [From Supabase](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/migrations/supabase.md): Effortlessly migrate from Supabase to Appwrite. Discover migration strategies, data transfer methods, and tips for a smooth transition to Appwrite.
- [From Nhost](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/migrations/nhost.md): Transition to Appwrite from NHost with confidence. Explore migration steps, considerations, and tools to ensure a successful migration process.
- [From Cloud](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/migrations/cloud.md): Self-hosted application migration made easy with Appwrite. Discover the steps and strategies for migrating your self-hosted apps to Appwrite's managed platform.
- [From self-hosted](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/migrations/self-hosted.md): Migrate to Appwrite from self-hosted platforms seamlessly. Learn how to move your applications and data to Appwrite for enhanced flexibility and control.

## Security

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security.md): Learn how Appwrite keeps your project, users, and data secure through security measures and compliance.

### Compliances

- [GDPR](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/gdpr.md): The safeguarding of your and your users' data is taken seriously at Appwrite. Learn about Appwrite's measures and compliance with the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
- [PCI](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/pci.md): Learn about Appwrite's measure to achieve PCI compliance when handling payments and transactions, ensuring secure and safe handling of payment information and personal data.
- [SOC 2](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/soc2.md): Learn about Appwrite Cloud's measures to achieve SOC 2 compliance.
- [HIPAA](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/hipaa.md): Learn about Appwrite Cloud's measures to achieve HIPAA compliance.
- [CCPA](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/ccpa.md): Protecting your and your users' data privacy is a priority at Appwrite. Learn about Appwrite's compliance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

### Measures

- [Authentication](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/authentication.md): Learn how Appwrite protects your passwords and helps users pick better passwords.
- [Encryption](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/encryption.md): Learn about Appwrite's use of encryption across Appwrite's databases and storage buckets to protect user data.
- [Multi-Factor authentication](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/mfa.md): Appwrite helps you secure your developer accounts with MFA (multi-factor authentication).
- [HTTPS](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/https.md): Learn how Appwrite Cloud enforces secure connections by enforcing HTTPS on all endpoints.
- [TLS](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/tls.md): Appwrite helps keep the web secure by generating TLS (Transport Layer Security) certificates for all user and generated domains.
- [Backups](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/backups.md): Appwrite provides both self-managed project backups and automated disaster recovery backups to ensure data security and availability.
- [Penetration tests](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/penetration-tests.md): Learn about how Appwrite keeps your data safe by employing manual third-party penetration tests to discover vulnerabilities.
- [Audit logs](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/audit-logs.md): Appwrite provides audit logs to help detect anomalies and investigate security incidents.
- [Abuse protection](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/abuse-protection.md): Learn how Appwrite protects your apps from abuse through rate limiting and cross-site scripting protection.

### Access control

- [Permissions](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/permissions.md): Enhance data security and access control with Appwrite platform permissions. Learn how to set fine-grained permissions to protect user data and resources.
- [Roles](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/roles.md): Learn how to setup role-based access controls in the Appwrite Console
- [Rate limits](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/rate-limits.md): Optimize application performance with Appwrite rate limits. Explore rate limiting strategies, configurations, and how to prevent abuse of your services.
- [Dev keys](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/security/dev-keys.md): Bypass Appwrite rate limits and CORS errors in your development environment with Appwrite Dev keys.

## Self-hosting

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting.md): Set up your self-hosted Appwrite instance easily. Read the installation guide to configure and deploy Appwrite on your infrastructure for complete control.
- [Installation](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/installation.md): Step-by-step guide to install Appwrite using Docker. Learn how to set up a self-hosted Appwrite instance with Docker Compose on any operating system.

### Platform deployment

- [AWS](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/platforms/aws.md): Deploy Appwrite on Amazon Web Services using the one-click Marketplace app.
- [DigitalOcean](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/platforms/digitalocean.md): Deploy Appwrite on DigitalOcean using the one-click Marketplace app.
- [Google Cloud](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/platforms/google-cloud.md): Deploy Appwrite on Google Cloud Platform using Compute Engine. Learn how to set up a production-ready Appwrite instance on GCP.
- [Azure](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/platforms/azure.md): Deploy Appwrite on Microsoft Azure using Virtual Machines. Learn how to set up a production-ready Appwrite instance on Azure.
- [Coolify](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/platforms/coolify.md): Learn how to self-host Appwrite on your infrastructure with Coolify.
- [Dokploy](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/platforms/dokploy.md): Learn how to self-host Appwrite on your infrastructure with Dokploy.

### Configuration

- [Databases](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/databases.md): Configure the database backend for your self-hosted Appwrite instance. Learn about the supported database options and their configuration.
- [Environment variables](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/environment-variables.md): Customize the behavior of your self-hosted Appwrite instance to your unique needs. Customize SMTP, SMS, functions, S3 adaptor, database, and other behaiors.
- [Email delivery](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/email.md): Configure email services for your self-hosted Appwrite instance. Learn how to set up email notifications, templates, and delivery for your applications.
- [SMS delivery](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/sms.md): Set up SMS services for your self-hosted Appwrite instance. Discover how to configure SMS notifications, verification, and messaging for your applications.
- [Functions](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/functions.md): Harness the full power of self-hosted functions with Appwrite. Explore function deployment, management, and integration in your self-hosted environment.
- [Sites](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/sites.md): Harness the full power of self-hosted sites with Appwrite. Explore site deployment, management, and integration in your self-hosted environment.
- [Storage](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/storage.md): Manage self-hosted storage options with Appwrite. Explore file storage, uploads, and customization in your self-hosted Appwrite environment.
- [TLS certificates](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/tls-certificates.md): Secure your self-hosted Appwrite instance with TLS certificates. Learn how to obtain, configure, and manage TLS certificates for enhanced security.
- [Version control](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/configuration/version-control.md): Configure version control integration for Functions and Sites in your self-hosted Appwrite instance.

### Production

- [Preparation](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/production.md): Optimize self-hosted Appwrite for production environments. Learn key concepts and best practices for deploying Appwrite in production.
- [Security](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/production/security.md): Implement essential security practices for your self-hosted Appwrite instance to protect your data and infrastructure.
- [Scaling](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/production/scaling.md): Learn how to scale your self-hosted Appwrite instance horizontally and vertically to handle increased load.
- [Rate limits](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/production/rate-limits.md): Configure rate limiting for your self-hosted Appwrite instance to protect against abuse and attacks.
- [Email delivery](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/production/emails.md): Configure reliable email delivery for your self-hosted Appwrite instance in production environments.
- [Error monitoring](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/production/errors.md): Configure error reporting and monitoring for your self-hosted Appwrite instance in production.
- [Backups](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/production/backups.md): Learn how to set up and manage backups for your self-hosted Appwrite instance to ensure data safety and disaster recovery.
- [Updates and migrations](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/production/updates.md): Keep your self-hosted Appwrite instance up-to-date. Learn how to perform updates, manage versions, and ensure your self-hosted Appwrite stays current.
- [Debugging](https://appwrite.io/docs/advanced/self-hosting/production/debugging.md): Master debugging techniques for self-hosted Appwrite. Discover best practices and tools for troubleshooting and maintaining a robust deployment.

## APIs

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis.md): Explore the ways to talk to Appwrite. Access every service through the REST and GraphQL APIs, subscribe to changes in Realtime, and react to events with webhooks.

### Protocols

- [REST](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/rest.md): Discover the Appwrite REST API for building robust and scalable applications. Access detailed documentation on REST endpoints, authentication, and data management.
- [GraphQL](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/graphql.md): Get to know Appwrite GraphQL API for flexible data querying & manipulation. Our docs cover the schema, queries, mutations, integration tips and more.
- [Realtime](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/realtime.md): Want to build dynamic and interactive applications with real-time data updates? Appwrite Realtime API makes it possible, get started with our intro guide.

### Concepts

- [Events](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/events.md): Harness the power of events in Appwrite. Explore event-driven architecture, event types, and how to use events to create dynamic applications.
- [Webhooks](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/webhooks.md): Leverage webhooks in the Appwrite platform for real-time updates. Learn how to configure, manage, and integrate webhooks to keep your applications in sync.
- [Response codes](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/response-codes.md): Understand Appwrite platform response codes and error handling. Learn to interpret HTTP status codes, error types, and implement best practices for handling errors gracefully.

### Policies

- [Release policy](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/release-policy.md): Understand how Appwrite releases and versions its platforms and APIs.

## Realtime

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/realtime.md): Want to build dynamic and interactive applications with real-time data updates? Appwrite Realtime API makes it possible, get started with our intro guide.
- [Authentication](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/realtime/authentication.md): Learn how authentication works with Appwrite Realtime subscriptions and how to handle session-based access.
- [Subscribe](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/realtime/subscribe.md): Learn how to subscribe to realtime events from Appwrite services. Subscribe to single or multiple channels and manage your subscriptions.

### Concepts

- [Channels](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/realtime/channels.md): Explore the available Realtime channels and learn how to use Channel helpers for type-safe subscriptions in Appwrite.
- [Queries](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/realtime/queries.md): Filter realtime events using queries. Use familiar SDK query methods to receive only the updates that match your conditions.
- [Payload](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/realtime/payload.md): Understand the structure of Appwrite Realtime subscription payloads and learn how to work with the response data.
- [Presences](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/realtime/presences.md): Use the Appwrite Presences API to track which users are currently active, broadcast their status, and subscribe to live presence updates over Realtime.

### Configuration

- [Custom endpoint](https://appwrite.io/docs/apis/realtime/custom-endpoint.md): Learn how to configure a custom WebSocket endpoint for the Appwrite Realtime API when using a custom proxy.

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/apps.md): Register and manage OAuth apps with the Appwrite Console Apps API. Publish integrations, manage client secrets, and connect users through OAuth 2.0.
- [Quick start](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/apps/quick-start.md): Register an app and run the full Sign in with Appwrite flow, from consent screen to your first authorized API call.

### Concepts

- [Registration](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/apps/registration.md): Register your app for Sign in with Appwrite through the Console.
- [Scopes](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/apps/scopes.md): The Sign in with Appwrite scope catalog, and how grants target the projects and organizations a user chooses.
- [Consent](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/apps/consent.md): What users see on the Sign in with Appwrite consent screen, what they can change, and what your app receives.
- [Tokens](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/apps/tokens.md): Use, refresh, and revoke the tokens Appwrite issues to your app through Sign in with Appwrite.
- [Device flow](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/apps/device-flow.md): Sign in with Appwrite from TVs, CLIs, and other input-constrained devices with the OAuth2 device authorization grant.

## Project

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project.md): Configure your Appwrite project, including auth methods, platforms, protocols, services, and policies.

### Concepts

- [Auth methods](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/auth-methods.md): Enable or disable authentication methods on your Appwrite project programmatically using server SDKs.
- [OAuth providers](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/oauth.md): Configure OAuth2 sign-in providers for your project from the Console or programmatically with a Server SDK.
- [API keys](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/api-keys.md): Secure your application with Appwrite API Keys. Discover how to create and manage API keys to control access and enhance your application's security.
- [Platforms](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/platforms.md): Register Web, Apple, Android, Windows, and Linux apps to your Appwrite project programmatically using server SDKs.
- [Protocols](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/protocols.md): Enable or disable the REST, GraphQL, and WebSocket protocols on your Appwrite project programmatically using server SDKs.
- [Services](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/services.md): Enable or disable individual Appwrite services on your project programmatically using server SDKs.
- [Policies](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/policies.md): Configure password rules, session limits, user limits, and membership privacy on your Appwrite project programmatically using server SDKs.
- [Mock phones](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/mock-phones.md): Register fictional phone numbers and OTPs to test phone authentication flows without sending real SMS messages.
- [Environment variables](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/environment-variables.md): Use project, function, and site environment variables to pass constants and secrets to your Appwrite Functions and Appwrite Sites at build and runtime.
- [SMTP](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/smtp.md): Configure a custom SMTP server to send Appwrite's account management emails from your own domain, improve deliverability, and unlock custom email templates.
- [Email templates](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/email-templates.md): Customize the account management emails Appwrite sends to your users, including verification, password recovery, and magic URL emails, per locale.
- [Labels](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/labels.md): Assign customizable labels to your Appwrite project to categorize and filter projects within an organization.

### Guides

- [Provisioning](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/provisioning.md): Apply a standard configuration to a customer's project programmatically with the Project API, including platforms, auth methods, services, protocols, and variables.
- [Key rotation](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/key-rotation.md): Manage the full life of an API key with the Project API, from issuing a scoped credential to auditing, rotating, and revoking it.
- [Branded emails](https://appwrite.io/docs/partners/project/branded-emails.md): Route a customer's project emails through their own SMTP server and rebrand the email templates per locale with the Project API.

## Agent

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent.md): Chat with the Appwrite Agent in the Console to inspect your project, explain issues, suggest next steps, and run approved actions.
- [Quick start](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/quick-start.md): Open the Appwrite Agent in the Console, ask your first question, and optionally connect MCP so it can take actions.

### Concepts

- [Conversations](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/conversations.md): Learn how Appwrite Agent conversations work, including threading, attachments, voice, and conversation management.
- [Actions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/actions.md): Learn what the Appwrite Agent can inspect, clarify, and do in your projects and in the Console.
- [MCP connections](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/mcp.md): Learn how the Appwrite Agent uses MCP servers to call tools and take actions in your projects.
- [Models](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/models.md): Learn how Appwrite Agent models work, including the default model and bring-your-own provider keys.
- [Memory](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/memory.md): Learn how Appwrite Agent memory stores preferences, instructions, and facts across conversations.
- [Automations](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/automations.md): Learn how Appwrite Agent automations run scheduled prompts and create conversations on a cron schedule.

### Guides

- [Chat with the Agent](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/chat.md): Open the Appwrite Agent panel or fullscreen chat, send prompts, and manage a conversation.
- [Connect Appwrite MCP](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/connect-mcp.md): Authorize Appwrite MCP so Appwrite Agent can take approved actions in your projects.
- [Add a custom model](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/add-model.md): Register a provider API key so the Appwrite Agent can use your own LLM credentials.
- [Add memory](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/add-memory.md): Save a preference, instruction, or fact for the Appwrite Agent to reuse across conversations.
- [Create an automation](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent/create-automation.md): Schedule a recurring Appwrite Agent prompt with a cron schedule and optional model.

## Auth

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth.md): Explore Appwrite's powerful authentication solutions. Learn how to implement secure user authentication, manage user identities, and enhance your application's security."
- [Quick start](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/quick-start.md): Effortlessly add authentication to your apps - simple signup & login in just minutes with Appwrite Authentication

### Concepts

- [Accounts](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/accounts.md): Unlock advanced user management - Appwrite's Account API for seamless signups, authentication, and dynamic permissions.
- [Users](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/users.md): Manage user identities and profiles effectively with Appwrite. Dive into user management features, account settings, and user data customization
- [Teams](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/teams.md): Master team management in the Appwrite Cloud. Explore team-related functions, permissions, and more.
- [Impersonation](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/impersonation.md): Let trusted operators act as another user in Appwrite Auth for support, QA, and troubleshooting while keeping the flow controlled and auditable.
- [Preferences](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/preferences.md): Store and manage user preferences in Appwrite using Account API and Teams API for individual and shared settings.
- [Labels](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/labels.md): Organize your users and grant custom permissions for subscriptions or VIP users with labels.
- [Security](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/security.md): Prioritize security in your applications with Appwrite. Discover best practices, security features, and guidelines to protect user data and ensure authentication integrity.

## DocumentsDB

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb.md): Store and query schemaless documents with Appwrite DocumentsDB. Collections give you flexible, JSON-style storage for your application, business, and user data.
- [Quick start](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/quick-start.md): Get started with Appwrite DocumentsDB. Follow a step-by-step guide to create your first database, add a collection, and perform basic document operations.

### Concepts

- [Databases](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/databases.md): Dive deeper into Appwrite DocumentsDB and database configuration. Learn how to create and manage multiple databases for your application.
- [Collections](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/collections.md): Organize documents with Appwrite DocumentsDB collections. Learn how to create collections, configure permissions, and add indexes for fast queries.
- [Documents](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/documents.md): Create, read, update, and delete documents in Appwrite DocumentsDB. Learn how to work with schemaless JSON documents in your collections.
- [Permissions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/permissions.md): Control access to your DocumentsDB data with permissions. Learn how to set collection level and document level access rules.
- [Queries](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/queries.md): Harness the power of querying with Appwrite DocumentsDB. Discover various query options, filtering, sorting, and advanced querying techniques.
- [Order](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/order.md): Understand how to do data ordering in Appwrite DocumentsDB. Learn how to order and sort your database records for efficient data retrieval.
- [Backups](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/backups.md): Learn how to back up and restore your DocumentsDB databases, ensuring data security and seamless recovery.

### Guides

- [Pagination](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/pagination.md): Implement pagination for large data sets in Appwrite DocumentsDB. Explore techniques for splitting and displaying data across multiple pages.
- [Transactions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/transactions.md): Stage multiple database operations and commit them atomically. Group changes across databases and collections with ordering, isolation, and conflict detection.
- [Bulk operations](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/bulk-operations.md): Perform bulk operations on documents within your collections for efficient data handling.
- [Atomic numeric operations](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/atomic-numeric-operations.md): Safely increment and decrement numeric fields without race conditions. Perfect for counters, quotas, inventory, and usage metrics in high-concurrency applications.
- [Timestamp overrides](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/timestamp-overrides.md): Set custom $createdAt and $updatedAt timestamps for your documents when using server SDKs.
- [JSON imports](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/json-imports.md): Create documents in a DocumentsDB collection by uploading a JSON file. Seed test data, restore a dataset, or migrate from another system without writing custom scripts.
- [JSON exports](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/documentsdb/json-exports.md): Export documents from a DocumentsDB collection to a JSON file. Share datasets, create custom backups, or move data to another system without writing custom scripts.

## MySQL

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql.md): Run a native MySQL database provisioned for your project and connect to it directly with standard MySQL clients.
- [Quick start](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/quick-start.md): Create your first native MySQL database in the Appwrite Console, retrieve its credentials, and run your first queries with the mysql client.

### Concepts

- [Tables and data types](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/concepts/tables.md): Create MySQL tables with the right column types and constraints. Covers numeric, string, date and time, JSON, ENUM, and generated columns.
- [Querying rows](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/concepts/queries.md): Read and write MySQL rows with SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE. Covers filtering, aggregation, pagination, and upserts.
- [Joins and relationships](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/concepts/joins.md): Model relationships with foreign keys and combine MySQL tables with INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and CROSS joins.
- [Indexes](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/concepts/indexes.md): Speed up MySQL queries with B-tree, composite, prefix, functional, and invisible indexes, and read EXPLAIN ANALYZE output.
- [Transactions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/concepts/transactions.md): Group MySQL statements into atomic transactions. Covers COMMIT, ROLLBACK, savepoints, isolation levels, locking, and deadlocks.
- [Data modeling](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/concepts/data-modeling.md): Design MySQL schemas with normalization, decide when to denormalize, and use views to shape data for readers.
- [Security and access control](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/concepts/access-control.md): How MySQL privileges work, what the admin account on your database can do, and patterns for restricting access to data.

### Connecting

- [Connections](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/connections.md): Connect to your MySQL database with the mysql client or any standard driver. Retrieve connection details and rotate the primary password.
- [Connection pooling](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/connection-pooling.md): Configure the per-database connection pooler to serve many short-lived clients, with automatic read/write splitting when high availability is enabled.

### Manage

- [Backups](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/backups.md): Scheduled backups, manual backups, restores, and point-in-time recovery for your MySQL database.
- [Branches](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/branches.md): Spin up an ephemeral, isolated copy of your MySQL database in seconds from a storage snapshot. Use branches for previews, migrations, and testing.
- [High availability](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/high-availability.md): Run up to five read replicas with asynchronous, synchronous, or quorum replication and automatic failover for your MySQL database.
- [Scaling](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/scaling.md): Resize the compute specification of your MySQL database with zero downtime and grow storage automatically as your data grows.
- [Network security](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/network-security.md): TLS by default, IP allowlists, and idle timeouts for your MySQL database.
- [Monitoring](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/monitoring.md): Check database health, watch lifecycle states, and inspect active connections on your native MySQL database.
- [Maintenance](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/maintenance.md): Maintenance windows, online engine version upgrades, pause and resume, and the lifecycle states of your MySQL database.

### Integrations

- [Node.js drivers](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/drivers.md): Connect to an Appwrite native MySQL database from Node.js with mysql2 or MariaDB Connector/Node.js. Configure pools, TLS verification, serverless connection management, and troubleshooting.
- [Prisma](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/prisma.md): Use Prisma ORM with an Appwrite native MySQL database. Configure the Prisma 7 datasource, apply schema changes through the direct connection, and instantiate Prisma Client with the MySQL driver adapter.
- [Drizzle](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/drizzle.md): Use Drizzle ORM with an Appwrite native MySQL database. Configure mysql2, run migrations against the direct connection, and pool runtime traffic from serverless environments.
- [Auth.js](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/auth-js.md): Use an Appwrite native MySQL database as the backing store for Auth.js (NextAuth.js). Persist users, accounts, and sessions through the Prisma adapter.
- [Better Auth](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/better-auth.md): Use an Appwrite native MySQL database as the database for Better Auth. Configure mysql2, run schema generation and migrations over a direct connection, and store users and sessions in MySQL.
- [Laravel](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/laravel.md): Use Laravel and Eloquent with an Appwrite native MySQL database. Configure the connection, run migrations against the direct port, and pool serverless traffic through the connection pooler.
- [Rails](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/rails.md): Use Ruby on Rails and ActiveRecord with an Appwrite native MySQL database. Configure database.yml, run migrations against the direct database port, and size the ActiveRecord pool.
- [Django](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/django.md): Use Django's ORM with an Appwrite native MySQL database. Configure the DATABASES setting, run migrations against the direct MySQL port, and choose the right pooler mode for Django connections.
- [FastAPI](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/fastapi.md): Use FastAPI and SQLAlchemy 2.x with an Appwrite native MySQL database. Configure the async asyncmy engine, pass TLS through connect_args, inject a session per request, and run Alembic migrations against the direct database port.
- [Spring Boot](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/spring-boot.md): Connect a Spring Boot application to an Appwrite native MySQL database with Spring Data JPA and Hibernate. Configure the JDBC datasource and HikariCP pool, map entities, and run Flyway or Liquibase migrations against MySQL.
- [EF Core](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/ef-core.md): Use Entity Framework Core with an Appwrite native MySQL database. Configure the MySQL provider, run migrations against the direct MySQL host, and rely on the provider's connection pool from an ASP.NET server.
- [GORM](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/gorm.md): Use GORM with an Appwrite native MySQL database in Go. Build the MySQL DSN, open a connection, size the database/sql pool, and run migrations with AutoMigrate or golang-migrate.
- [Next.js](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/nextjs.md): Connect a Next.js App Router application to an Appwrite native MySQL database from Route Handlers, Server Actions, and Server Components, pool from serverless, and fall back to the SQL API on the Edge runtime.
- [dbt](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/dbt.md): Run dbt Core transformations against an Appwrite native MySQL database with the community dbt-mysql adapter.
- [Metabase](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/metabase.md): Connect Metabase to an Appwrite native MySQL database for analytics. Configure MySQL connection details, require TLS on Cloud, and build dashboards on a session-safe connection.
- [Grafana](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/grafana.md): Connect Grafana to an Appwrite native MySQL database as a data source and build dashboards. Configure the MySQL data source and provision it from YAML.
- [Retool](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/mysql/integrations/retool.md): Connect Retool to an Appwrite native MySQL database to build internal and admin tools. Fetch connection details with the API, configure the MySQL resource with TLS, and allow Retool Cloud network access when needed.

### Getting started

- [Querying rows](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/concepts/queries.md): Read and write PostgreSQL rows with SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE. Covers filtering, aggregation, pagination, and upserts.
- [Joins and relationships](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/concepts/joins.md): Model relationships with foreign keys and combine PostgreSQL tables with INNER, LEFT, FULL, and CROSS joins.
- [Indexes](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/concepts/indexes.md): Speed up PostgreSQL queries with B-tree, composite, partial, and expression indexes, and read EXPLAIN ANALYZE output.
- [Transactions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/concepts/transactions.md): Group PostgreSQL statements into atomic transactions. Covers COMMIT, ROLLBACK, savepoints, isolation levels, locking, and deadlocks.
- [Data modeling](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/concepts/data-modeling.md): Design PostgreSQL schemas with normalization, decide when to denormalize, and use views to shape data for readers.
- [Security and access control](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/concepts/access-control.md): Control access to PostgreSQL with roles, GRANT and REVOKE, and row-level security policies for multi-tenant data.

- [Backups](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/backups.md): Scheduled backups, manual backups, restores, and point-in-time recovery for your PostgreSQL database.
- [Branches](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/branches.md): Spin up an ephemeral, isolated copy of your PostgreSQL database in seconds from a storage snapshot. Use branches for previews, migrations, and testing.
- [High availability](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/high-availability.md): Run up to five read replicas with asynchronous, synchronous, or quorum replication and automatic failover for your PostgreSQL database.
- [Scaling](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/scaling.md): Resize the compute specification of your PostgreSQL database with zero downtime and grow storage automatically as your data grows.
- [Network security](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/network-security.md): TLS by default, IP allowlists, and idle timeouts for your PostgreSQL database.
- [Monitoring](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/monitoring.md): Watch compute, connections, storage, and workload metrics live, inspect active connections, and check database health on your PostgreSQL database.
- [Maintenance](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/maintenance.md): Maintenance windows, online engine version upgrades, pause and resume, and the lifecycle states of your PostgreSQL database.

### Integrations

- [Node.js drivers](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/drivers.md): Connect to an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database from Node.js with node-postgres or postgres.js. Configure pools, TLS verification, serverless connection management, and troubleshooting.

- [Drizzle](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/drizzle.md): Use Drizzle ORM with an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database. Configure the driver, run migrations against the direct connection, and pool runtime traffic from serverless environments.
- [Auth.js](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/auth-js.md): Use an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database as the backing store for Auth.js (NextAuth.js). Persist users, accounts, and sessions through a Prisma or Drizzle adapter, pooled from serverless runtimes.
- [Better Auth](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/better-auth.md): Use an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database as the database for Better Auth. Point runtime traffic at the pooler, run schema generation and migrations over a direct connection, and store users and sessions in PostgreSQL.
- [Laravel](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/laravel.md): Use Laravel and Eloquent with an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database. Configure the connection, run migrations against the direct port, and pool serverless traffic through the connection pooler.
- [Rails](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/rails.md): Use Ruby on Rails and ActiveRecord with an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database. Configure database.yml, run migrations against the direct database port, and size the ActiveRecord pool.
- [Django](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/django.md): Use Django's ORM with an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database. Configure the DATABASES setting with TLS options, run migrations on the direct PostgreSQL port, and tune persistent connections for pooling.
- [FastAPI](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/fastapi.md): Use FastAPI and SQLAlchemy 2.x with an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database. Configure the async asyncpg engine, pass TLS through connect_args, inject a session per request, and run Alembic migrations against the direct database port.
- [Spring Boot](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/spring-boot.md): Connect a Spring Boot application to an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database with Spring Data JPA and Hibernate. Configure the JDBC datasource and HikariCP pool, map entities, and run Flyway or Liquibase migrations against PostgreSQL.
- [EF Core](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/ef-core.md): Use Entity Framework Core with an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database. Configure the Npgsql connection string, run migrations against the direct PostgreSQL host, and rely on the driver's built-in connection pool from an ASP.NET server.
- [GORM](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/gorm.md): Use GORM with an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database in Go. Build the DSN, open a connection, size the database/sql pool against the direct connection, and run migrations with AutoMigrate or golang-migrate.
- [Next.js](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/nextjs.md): Connect a Next.js App Router application to an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database from Route Handlers, Server Actions, and Server Components, pool from serverless, and fall back to the SQL API on the Edge runtime.
- [dbt](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/dbt.md): Run dbt transformations against an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database. Configure profiles.yml for the direct engine port, size threads to your connection budget, and test models against a branch in CI.
- [Metabase](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/metabase.md): Connect Metabase to an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database for analytics. Use a read-only PostgreSQL role, configure SSL, and build dashboards on a session-safe connection.
- [Grafana](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/grafana.md): Connect Grafana to an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database as a data source and build dashboards. Create a read-only reporting role, configure the PostgreSQL data source with TLS, and provision it from YAML.
- [Retool](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/postgresql/integrations/retool.md): Connect Retool to an Appwrite native PostgreSQL database to build internal and admin tools. Retrieve credentials from the Console, configure the PostgreSQL resource with TLS, and allow Retool Cloud network access when needed.

## Databases

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb.md): Store and query structured data with Appwrite TablesDB. Tables provide performant and scalable storage for your application, business, and user data.
- [Quick start](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/quick-start.md): Get started with Appwrite Databases. Follow a step-by-step guide to create your first database, define tables, and perform basic data operations.

### Concepts

- [Databases](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/databases.md): Dive deeper into Appwrite Databases and their configuration. Learn how to create, manage, and optimize multiple databases for your application.
- [Tables](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/tables.md): Organize your data with Appwrite Tables. Explore how to create and configure tables to store and structure your data effectively.
- [Rows](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/rows.md): Master row management with Appwrite Databases. Learn how to create, update, upsert, and query rows within your tables for dynamic data storage.
- [Permissions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/permissions.md): Enhance data security and access control with Appwrite Database Permissions. Learn how to set permissions and access rules for your database tables
- [Relationships](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/relationships.md): Manage complex data relationships with Appwrite Databases. Discover how to define and work with relationships between rows for interconnected data.
- [Queries](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/queries.md): Harness the power of querying with Appwrite tablesDB. Discover various query options, filtering, sorting, and advanced querying techniques.
- [Order](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/order.md): Understand how to do data ordering in Appwrite Databases. Learn how to order and sort your database records for efficient data retrieval.
- [Operators](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/operators.md): Update multiple fields atomically without fetching the full row. Perform numeric, array, string, and date updates in a single, consistent workflow.
- [Geo queries](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/geo-queries.md): Query geographic data with distance, intersects, overlaps, and other location-based operations using spatial columns.
- [Backups](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/backups.md): Learn how to efficiently back up your databases on Appwrite Cloud, ensuring data security and seamless recovery.

- [Pagination](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/pagination.md): Implement pagination for large data sets in Appwrite Databases. Explore techniques for splitting and displaying data across multiple pages.
- [Transactions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/transactions.md): Stage multiple database operations and commit them atomically. Group changes across databases and tables with ordering, isolation, and conflict detection.
- [Type generation](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/type-generation.md): Generate types from your Appwrite database schema. Learn how to use the Appwrite CLI to create and manage your types effectively.
- [Offline sync](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/offline.md): Enable offline synchronization of data between your apps and Appwrite Databases.
- [Bulk operations](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/bulk-operations.md): Perform bulk operations on rows within your tables for efficient data handling.
- [Atomic numeric operations](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/atomic-numeric-operations.md): Safely increment and decrement numeric fields without race conditions. Perfect for counters, quotas, inventory, and usage metrics in high-concurrency applications.
- [CSV imports](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/csv-imports.md): Master row imports with Appwrite's CSV Import feature. Learn how to create rows within your tables by uploading a CSV file.
- [CSV exports](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/csv-exports.md): Export table data to CSV files from the Console. Share clean datasets with your team without writing custom scripts.
- [AI suggestions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/ai-suggestions.md): Use AI suggestions to automatically generate database schemas. Learn how to create tables with recommended columns and indexes based on your table name and context.
- [Timestamp overrides](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/tablesdb/timestamp-overrides.md): Set custom $createdAt and $updatedAt timestamps for your rows when using server SDKs.

- [Documents](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/documents.md): Create, read, update, and delete documents in Appwrite VectorsDB. Learn how to store embedding vectors and metadata in your collections.
- [Embeddings](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/embeddings.md): Generate text embeddings with Appwrite VectorsDB. Turn text into vector embeddings with built-in models and store them in your documents for vector search.
- [Permissions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/permissions.md): Control access to your VectorsDB data with permissions. Learn how to set collection level and document level access rules.

- [Order](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/order.md): Order documents returned by Appwrite VectorsDB. Learn how to sort by system fields like $createdAt and $sequence, and why metadata sub-fields can't be ordered.

### Guides

- [Pagination](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/pagination.md): Implement pagination for large data sets in Appwrite VectorsDB. Explore techniques for splitting and displaying documents across multiple pages.
- [Vector search](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/vector-search.md): Run similarity search over your documents with Appwrite VectorsDB. Create an HNSW index on the embeddings field and rank documents by cosine, dot product, or Euclidean distance.
- [Transactions](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/transactions.md): Stage multiple VectorsDB operations and commit them atomically. Group changes across databases and collections with ordering, isolation, and conflict detection.
- [Bulk operations](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/bulk-operations.md): Perform bulk operations on documents within your collections for efficient data handling in Appwrite VectorsDB.

- [CSV imports](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/csv-imports.md): Import embeddings into Appwrite VectorsDB by uploading a CSV file. Learn how to format the embeddings and metadata columns for a bulk import.
- [CSV exports](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/databases/vectorsdb/csv-exports.md): Export VectorsDB documents to a CSV file. Share embeddings and metadata as a portable dataset without writing custom scripts.

### Tooling

- [Appwrite Agent](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/agent.md): Chat with the Appwrite Agent in the Console to inspect your project, explain issues, suggest next steps, and run approved actions.

- [Agent skills](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/ai/skills.md): Install Appwrite skills to give AI agents pre-built knowledge of Appwrite SDKs and services for your preferred language.
- [AGENTS.md](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/ai/agents-md.md): Generate an AGENTS.md file to give AI agents project-specific context about Appwrite SDKs, APIs, and services.
- [Appwrite Arena](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/ai/arena.md): An open-source benchmark that evaluates how well AI models understand Appwrite's services, SDKs, and APIs.

## Terraform provider

### Getting started

- [Overview](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform.md): Manage Appwrite infrastructure as code with the official Terraform provider. Works with Appwrite Cloud and Community Edition.
- [Configuration](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform/provider.md): Configure the Appwrite Terraform provider for Cloud or Community Edition using endpoints, API keys, and optional environment variables.

### Resources

- [Databases](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform/resources/databases.md): Use Terraform to manage Appwrite TablesDB databases, tables, columns, indexes, and rows with the official Appwrite provider.
- [Storage](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform/resources/storage.md): Manage Appwrite Storage buckets and files with the Terraform provider, including file limits, extensions, compression, and security options.
- [Messaging](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform/resources/messaging.md): Configure Appwrite Messaging providers, topics, and subscribers with Terraform for email, SMS, and push delivery.
- [Auth](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform/resources/auth.md): Manage Appwrite users and teams with the Terraform provider.
- [Functions](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform/resources/functions.md): Manage Appwrite Functions, environment variables, and deployments with Terraform.
- [Sites](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform/resources/sites.md): Manage Appwrite Sites, environment variables, and deployments with Terraform.
- [Webhooks](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform/resources/webhooks.md): Register Appwrite webhooks with Terraform to deliver events to your HTTP endpoints.
- [Backups](https://appwrite.io/docs/tooling/terraform/resources/backups.md): Configure Appwrite backup policies with Terraform where your plan supports them.

- [Define the scopes](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/custom-scopes/step-2.md): Add tasks.read and tasks.write to your OAuth2 server's scopes.
- [Request the scopes](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/custom-scopes/step-3.md): Ask for the task scopes during authorization and let the user grant each one individually.
- [Validate access tokens](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/custom-scopes/step-4.md): Verify incoming access tokens against your project's JWKS and read their scopes.
- [Protect the API route](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/custom-scopes/step-5.md): Serve tasks only to tokens that carry tasks.read.
- [Call the API from Vantage](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/custom-scopes/step-6.md): Read tasks with the granted access token and add a task composer that lives or dies by its scope.
- [Run the flow](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/custom-scopes/step-7.md): Grant the read scope, watch a write get refused, then grant the write scope and watch it succeed.
- [Enable the OAuth2 server](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/sign-in-with-your-product/step-2.md): Turn on the OAuth2 server on your Appwrite project and register the client app.
- [Create the apps](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/sign-in-with-your-product/step-3.md): Scaffold the two TanStack Start apps and wire up their environment.
- [Add Sign in with your product](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/sign-in-with-your-product/step-4.md): Build the consumer's sign-in button and the redirect that starts the OAuth flow.
- [Build the consent screen](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/sign-in-with-your-product/step-5.md): Host the consent screen where your users sign in and approve access.
- [Exchange the code for tokens](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/sign-in-with-your-product/step-6.md): Handle the callback, exchange the authorization code for tokens on the server, and sign the user in.
- [Run the flow](https://appwrite.io/docs/products/auth/oauth-server/sign-in-with-your-product/step-7.md): Start both apps and sign in with your product end to end.
